# Pro API declaration metadata

The offline extension API catalog extracts method signatures and type names from JLCEDA / EasyEDA Pro declarations. It contains no upstream runtime implementation.

- Latest reference source: `@jlceda/pro-api-types@0.4.26`, Apache-2.0, published 2026-09-28. Copyright JLCEDA.
- Official declaration URL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@jlceda/pro-api-types@0.4.26/index.d.ts
- SHA-256: `7b2a0407ec516ea3f5021c8373d24cdced2a3946f990a4a524ec3ec394a1173f`.
- The reviewed installed declaration snapshot is separately identified by public API build `0.2.53.aee2f57a` and SHA-256 `32a0d2f8b4bc3d7b2b93b33499d9d768b0c23c77f45843a65166cf4e8ad6dab1`. It is not interchangeable with the npm package of the same numeric version.
- The separately named `installed-209` reference records installed public API build `0.3.59.1ca9efb5` in application `3.2.209.8a704eab`, extracted on 2026-10-23. Its declaration is 1,814,791 bytes with SHA-256 `0a6910f4108f3d09733a9de9176b20c41ccd2a87fc4e335f8d6d656eb054ba72`. Only signature/type metadata is packaged, without implementation or descriptive prose. It does not replace either prior snapshot or admit runtime methods.
- The separate `packaged-4197` candidate records API `0.3.69.f840f579` from application `4.1.97.04b092ac`, statically inspected on 2026-11-06. Its declaration is 1,857,649 bytes with SHA-256 `773046ae11ae9291215226858c7dfc9f8121bbba5f0e7c71d29cd7aa53c81257`. It came from `resources/app/assets/pro-api/0.3.69.f840f579/api-types.d.ts` in the [official Linux archive](https://image.lceda.cn/files/lceda-pro-linux-x64-4.1.97.zip), archive SHA-256 `106133757742048009973b034ff2455a70226b6950241ed65ca334cf26f19071`. Only signatures/type names are packaged. The application, its implementation and raw declaration remain excluded. This is not an installed runtime or an Apache license claim for the packaged application; the npm reference's license remains separate.
- The catalog generator removes implementation and descriptive prose, retains signatures, ordering-independent inventories, source line numbers and stability tags, and adds plugin-specific pagination and non-execution labels.
- Apache License 2.0 is reproduced in [LICENSE](LICENSE). EasyEDA and JLCEDA names identify compatibility and sources; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.
